logic: Iterates over the collection `shipInfo` which contains `CartShipInfo` objects. For each element, it retrieves the `shipEstimate` (a BigDecimal) and adds it to an accumulator (`tempShipping`). After processing all elements, the accumulator holds the sum of all shipping estimates and is returned as the total shipping cost.
mathematical_formula: total_shipping = Σ shipEstimate_i   for i = 1 .. N (where N = shipInfo.size())
